summary: This directory acts as the authoritative module for managing administrative user identity identifiers. It ensures consistent generation and structure of unique IDs specifically for administrative accounts, serving as a dedicated namespace for admin-level user identification logic.
responsibilities: Generate unique identifiers for administrative accounts
Maintain consistent structure for administrative identities
Encapsulate logic for user identifier assignment
relationships: The administrator identifier serves as the unique key representing an administrative user within the user domain.
The generation logic strictly defines how an administrative identity is formed to ensure uniqueness.
designDecisions: Domain-specific isolation of administrative user logic
